_doc.about: chapters: an organised film, every text type in one fixed slot (the «ميار… بنت مصر» look, 2026-11-06). Built when the owner said the order was unclear; he later turned down numbered chapter cards for cinematic films, so numbers are off here: turn them on only when he asks for chapters.
_doc.numbers: true draws the gold numeral (n) above each chapter title; false keeps only the title and its gold line
_doc.chapters: top slot (y 300): n = numeral, title, start; each shows for dur seconds (2.6)
_doc.lines: her words as subtitles in the bottom slot (Tajawal 50 at y 1580), only while she says them
_doc.verses: Quran verse layer in ScheherazadeNew-Bold: text (from verses.json, letter for letter) with '|' between lines, ﴿ ﴾ drawn alone outside the RTL line, ref = sura and verse in gold below; no song should play under a recitation
_doc.lyrics: gold Ruqaa lyric band at y 1560 (only lyrics that were checked word for word)
_doc.lowers: TV lower-third at y 1330: text = the name (only a verified speaker), kicker = small gold line above
_doc.shots[].broll: aerials / library shots get 0.5 s dissolves; between two shots of her the dissolve is 0.16 s (no ghost double faces)
_doc.end: dims the footage; title (gold Ruqaa), sub (white), sub2 (gold Ruqaa), flag = red/white/black strip; credit 2 s later (never later than duration - 3, so it holds 3 s)
_doc._verses_example: rename to verses for a Quran film: verses never play under a song (--check fails), so this example with a song keeps them as a note
_doc.requirements: optional: the owner's request word for word, one item per demand; every shot or text that delivers one says "covers": ["r1"]; --check fails on a requirement nobody covers
_doc.other fields: same as examples/nil.json; never show two text items at once (title, chapters, lines, verses, labels, lowers and the end card each get their own seconds: --check warns on an overlap)

_verses_example.text: السطر الأول من الآية|السطر الثاني من الآية
